_readme: Held-out, UNSEEN paraphrases for the semantic-cache hit-rate test (PDF 6.2 target >= 80%). Written by the team with Claude (Anthropic) assistance - a different model family from the cache-building model (Groq gpt-oss-120b) - and never shown to the cache builder, so hit rate is not inflated by generator overlap. 3 per scenario across registers (formal / casual-or-frustrated / keyword-or-typo). A hit is CORRECT if the served entry is this scenario or returns an identical plan.
